text:
lisa: FYI found what looks like a KMS-wrapped secret inside a partner ingestion archive we pulled from S3. not posting the blob, id is BLOB_0a1b. seems to reference a crypto key resource. need triage + rotation plan.
owen: thanks lisa. any metadata from the archive (path, filename, timestamp)? we'll need to scope the blast radius.
lisa: archive path: partner-dumps/2026-03-22/ingest.log.gz. entry shows: sealed_blob=BLOB_0a1b; key_hint=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/partners-ingest-kms.
ben: ok. immediate actions: 1) confirm which service accounts have decrypt on that key, 2) create an ephemeral rewrap key in Vault so apps stay available during rewrap, 3) run small canary rewrap for affected ciphertexts, 4) tighten IAM for the key, 5) rotate and revoke old key versions + notify partners.
ravi: also enable KMS ADMIN audit logs and export to Pub/Sub -> GCS for 120d. we want raw unwrapping events in case of repeated exfil. ops-oncall, can you add a temporary sink?
ops-oncall: I can spin up a sink to pubsub topic redwood-kms-audit and a GCS bucket redwood-audit-raw. target retention 120d. prefer to do this now while we gather.
security-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-3140 created (type: potential secret exposure). Assigned eng-security and oncall.
owen: preflight checks I'll run:```bash
# list policy on key
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partners-ingest-kms --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod
# quickly enumerate ciphertexts in backup (locally)
grep -o "BLOB_[0-9a-f]+" /tmp/partner_dump/* | sort | uniq -c
```post results here.
ben: RBAC change proposal: remove any group or broad principals from the key binding. grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter only to serviceAccount:partners-ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com and to a short-lived glue account used by the rewrap job. make a conditional binding for requests coming from the ingest cluster IP range if conditions supported.
lisa: i can run an initial grep to see if other BLOB_ ids exist in the same dump; will paste count.
ops-oncall: scheduling: i'd prefer immediate audit sink + a midnight UTC rotation window (01:00 UTC) so we can do canary and full sweep with minimal traffic. need security approval and partner heads-up.
ravi: partner heads-up should be minimal: say "we detected possible exposure of encrypted blobs in a partner log archive; we are rotating keys that may affect your ingestion; please rotate any credentials in use and confirm by X hours." don't include the ciphertexts. legal copied.
security-bot: :memo: Action items: [x] incident INC-3140 created, [ ] audit sink, [ ] preflight enumeration, [ ] RBAC PR, [ ] rewrap canary, [ ] full rotate + partner confirm.
owen: sample rewrap dry-run I'll use (no secrets printed):```bash
# create new key version to target
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=partners-ingest-kms --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod --purpose=encryption
# perform dry-run of rewrap using internal tool (logs to secure runbook only)
python infra/rewrap_tool.py --dry-run --ciphertext-id BLOB_0a1b --from-key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/partners-ingest-kms --to-key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/partners-ingest-kms-v2
```will record outputs in the runbook.
ben: vault plan: create transit key "partners-rewrap-temp" in Vault, configure rewrap job to decrypt via CloudKMS -> re-encrypt to Vault transit -> write back. that lets us flip apps to Vault transit short-term if needed. after all canaries succeed flip Vault config to use the new KMS key directly or keep transit if partner ops request.
lisa: grep found 3 unique blob ids in that archive (BLOB_0a1b, BLOB_2c3d, BLOB_9f00). escalating if more.
ops-oncall: will create the runbook and include checkpoints + abort criteria. link will be posted here once done.
ravi: make sure to bump log retention on vault audit logs too while we investigate.
owen: if preflight shows additional blobs tied to the same key, we proceed to full rotation immediately and widen partner comms to include specific integration owners.
security-bot: :lock: Quick checklist status: incident created, preflight started, audit sink pending, RBAC PR pending, canary pending, partner notified (partial).
ben: please tag @security-review on the RBAC PR; we'll need a fast track approval. aim to merge RBAC before the rewrap.
lisa: i've notified the partner operations lead privately and asked them to rotate any credentials that may have been unintentionally logged.
ops-oncall: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-3140-rewrap (posting now). will update timestamps as steps complete.
owen: updating thread with preflight counts in ~10m. keep responses terse here so runbook remains the single source of truth.
lisa: thanks team. we'll use this thread for live status only.
